references.role: Sole exact design reference: isolate original NORMAL guardian equipment from character sheet; remove body, labels and other views.

visual_qa.identity: Single blunt ivory faceted stone club, broad polygon striking head, one gold four-point star and navy zigzag band, substantial short grip and faceted pommel. Original village-guardian weapon family retained.
visual_qa.composition: Single upright complete isolated club, mild three-quarter depth, neutral light gray background, matte surfaces and even soft lighting. No character, hand, text, collage, pedestal or duplicate prop. Object fills most of square image with close but uncut margins.
visual_qa.limits: Grip collar details partly inferred from original occluded handle. Back geometry and final mesh must be checked in Tripo.
